status: Source-only proposal for root/compositor/environment; not applied to candidate or production

settingsPrint.scale: Scale the single printed layer to current whole settings native face; roughly6px outer inset at1672. Ink and icon remain native.
settingsPrint.integration: Replace existing .settings::after rectangular print border with the irregular SVG print. Use one background print layer above the neutral overlay/map and below native text. Keep pointer-events:none and all native bounds/padding/fonts. Do not retain both printed borders.
settingsPrint.physicalEdge: Existing paper thickness/irregular physical edge/hooks remain separate; print contains no geometry, cast shadow or hook drawing.
settingsPrint.costIfNativeBackground: one512x128 browser image decode; CSS paint cost unmeasured. It does not add a Three texture. If a future physical front map is chosen instead, unique RGBA8 full-mip upper estimate .333333MiB; owned clone/material draw cost must be measured there. Never apply this print to all box sides automatically.

settingsGrading.reason: New paper map is neutraler but frozen native overlay and physical tint retain a pink cast. These are starting trial values for paired grading in owner scene, not an accepted result.

primaryInkTrial.reason: Preserve font/layout; improve small hint contrast on rare dark paper pixels. Source-only numeric proposal, compositor owns native implementation.

boardGoldLine.request: Refine existing retained inner brass line and corner hardware under common light; keep one physical line and retained frame. No second CSS frame or new border map.
boardGoldLine.integration: Use existing brass material/edge geometry, restrained patchy surface wear; evaluate with same camera/light. Preserve actual getCorners and native action/title insets. Geometry dimensions and material adjustment belong to their owner.

icon.changes: More compact rounded train front/cap and slimmer rails; same32 viewBox/currentColor/decorative semantics. Other five icons preserved.

titleFonts: Canonical six EUROPE paths and readable existing native labels preserved; no new font proposed.
